benefits_health_001.answer: yes; FUSD Employee Health Care Plan Document; bargaining unit members employed 50% or more.
benefits_health_001.evidence: The District shall provide District paid coverage (less the applicable employee contribution) for bargaining unit members and eligible dependents as specified within this Article and in the FUSD Employee Health Care Plan Document. / A bargaining unit member must be employed 50% or more to be eligible for FUSD's Health and Life Insurance Plans.
benefits_health_001.coder_notes: Added Section 1.4 quote to explicitly support the 50% employment requirement mentioned in the answer.

benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: $14,674 per active benefitted employee (2014-15 onward); district contribution rate starts at ~25% (2013-14), 40% (2014-15), and 50% (2015-16 onward).
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: Beginning in the 2014 15 school year the district's contribution shall be $14,674 per active benefitted employee. / Beginning in the 2013 14 school year the district's contribution to the health fund shall be one half 25% of the contribution per active benefitted employee for each $14,674 per active benefitted employee... This rate shall increase in the 2014 15 school year to 40%, and shall increase to 50% in the 2015 16 school year
